caption: ✨ Meet Lydie E. — The Woman Behind The Plot Twist After 50! 🥂💗 Who says your best chapters have to be behind you? Meet Berly — a trauma-informed coach helping women understand themselves, their patterns, and the emotional connections that can be difficult to break. 💜 Her work comes from a place of deep understanding and compassion. She creates space for women to look beneath the surface — to understand why they may keep returning to relationships or patterns that hurt them, why leaving can feel so difficult, and what may be happening emotionally beneath it all. Rather than simply telling women to “move on,” her approach focuses on awareness, understanding and healing — helping women recognize trauma bonds, understand their experiences, and begin building a stronger relationship with themselves. She also offers a FREE Breaking Trauma Bonds Webinar, giving women an opportunity to learn more about these patterns and gain a deeper understanding of what they may be experiencing. If this message resonates with you, take a moment to visit her profile, explore her work, and learn more about the woman behind this important work. 💜 . . . Meet Mehzabin Hamir — author of The Worthy Series, a collection of books created for women navigating growth, change, healing, self-trust, and becoming more grounded in who they are. 📚✨ Through her writing, Mehzabin explores the moments when we question our timing, our strength, our direction, and whether the life we’re building truly feels like our own. The Worthy Series brings together three meaningful reads: 📘 You Are Not Behind — a reminder to trust your own timing and let go of the pressure of feeling “late” in life. 📕 Soft Strength — discovering your inner power without believing you have to become harder to become stronger. 📗 Living Rooted — reconnecting with yourself, your values, and creating a life that genuinely feels like yours. Together, these books offer a journey of self-trust, inner strength, intentional living, and becoming more connected to yourself. 🤍 And to all the women building something of their own — your work deserves to be seen too.
